passages.text: O LORD, You are my God! I will exalt You; I will praise Your name. For You have worked wonders— plans formed long ago— in perfect faithfulness.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is my God.
I will lift You up, LORD.
I will praise Your name.
You have done wonderful things.
You made plans long ago.
You carried out these plans with perfect faithfulness.
passages.original: יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהַי֙ אַתָּ֔ה אֲרֽוֹמִמְךָ֙ אוֹדֶ֣ה שִׁמְךָ֔ כִּ֥י עָשִׂ֖יתָ פֶּ֑לֶא עֵצ֥וֹת מֵֽרָח֖וֹק אֱמ֥וּנָה אֹֽמֶן׃

passages.text: Indeed, You have made the city a heap of rubble, the fortified town a ruin. The fortress of strangers is a city no more; it will never be rebuilt.
passages.sermon:
God acted with power.
God turned the city into a heap of rubble.
God made the fortified town a ruin.
God destroyed the stronghold of foreigners.
That city will never be rebuilt.
passages.original: כִּ֣י שַׂ֤מְתָּ מֵעִיר֙ לַגָּ֔ל קִרְיָ֥ה בְצוּרָ֖ה לְמַפֵּלָ֑ה אַרְמ֤וֹן זָרִים֙ מֵעִ֔יר לְעוֹלָ֖ם לֹ֥א יִבָּנֶֽה׃

passages.text: Therefore, a strong people will honor You. The cities of ruthless nations will revere You.
passages.sermon: A strong people will honor You.\r\nCities of ruthless nations will fear You.
passages.original: עַל־ כֵּ֖ן יְכַבְּד֣וּךָ עַם־ עָ֑ז קִרְיַ֛ת גּוֹיִ֥ם עָרִיצִ֖ים יִירָאֽוּךָ׃

passages.text: For You have been a refuge for the poor, a stronghold for the needy in distress, a refuge from the storm, a shade from the heat. For the breath of the ruthless is like rain against a wall, like heat in a dry land. You subdue the uproar of foreigners. As the shade of a cloud cools the heat, so the song of the ruthless is silenced.
passages.sermon:
God is a refuge for the poor.
God is a stronghold for the needy in times of trouble.
God is a shelter from the storm.
God is a shade from the heat.
The breath of the ruthless is like a storm beating against a wall.
The breath of the ruthless is like heat in a dry land.
God subdues the noise of foreigners.
God silences the song of the ruthless, just as a cloud’s shade cools the heat.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ הָיִ֨יתָ מָע֥וֹז לַדָּ֛ל מָע֥וֹז לָאֶבְי֖וֹן בַּצַּר־ ל֑וֹ מַחְסֶ֤ה מִזֶּ֙רֶם֙ צֵ֣ל מֵחֹ֔רֶב כִּ֛י ר֥וּחַ עָרִיצִ֖ים כְּזֶ֥רֶם קִֽיר׃ כְּחֹ֣רֶב בְּצָי֔וֹן שְׁא֥וֹן זָרִ֖ים תַּכְנִ֑יעַ חֹ֚רֶב בְּצֵ֣ל עָ֔ב זְמִ֥יר עָֽרִיצִ֖ים יַעֲנֶֽה׃פ

passages.text: On this mountain the LORD of Hosts will prepare a banquet for all the peoples, a feast of aged wine, of choice meat, of finely aged wine.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts is God.
God has great power and authority.
God will act on this mountain.
God will prepare a banquet.
God will invite all peoples to this banquet.
The banquet will have choice meat.
The banquet will have aged wine.
The wine will be finely aged.
The food and drink will be the best.
passages.original: וְעָשָׂה֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת לְכָל־ הָֽעַמִּים֙ בָּהָ֣ר הַזֶּ֔ה מִשְׁתֵּ֥ה שְׁמָנִ֖ים מִשְׁתֵּ֣ה שְׁמָרִ֑ים שְׁמָנִים֙ מְמֻ֣חָיִ֔ם שְׁמָרִ֖ים מְזֻקָּקִֽים׃

passages.text: On this mountain He will swallow up the shroud that enfolds all peoples, the sheet that covers all nations; He will swallow up death forever. The Lord GOD will wipe away the tears from every face and remove the disgrace of His people from the whole earth. For the LORD has spoken.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD is the subject.
He has great power and authority.
On this mountain, He will act.
He will swallow up the shroud that covers all peoples.
He will remove the sheet that covers all nations.
He will swallow up death forever.
The Lord GOD will wipe away every tear from every face.
He will remove the disgrace of His people from the whole earth.
The LORD has spoken.
passages.original: וּבִלַּע֙ בָּהָ֣ר הַזֶּ֔ה פְּנֵֽי־ הַלּ֥וֹט׀ הַלּ֖וֹט עַל־ כָּל־ הָֽעַמִּ֑ים וְהַמַּסֵּכָ֥ה הַנְּסוּכָ֖ה עַל־ כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִֽם׃ בִּלַּ֤ע הַמָּ֙וֶת֙ לָנֶ֔צַח וּמָחָ֨ה אֲדֹנָ֧י יְהוִ֛ה דִּמְעָ֖ה מֵעַ֣ל כָּל־ פָּנִ֑ים וְחֶרְפַּ֣ת עַמּ֗וֹ יָסִיר֙ מֵעַ֣ל כָּל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר׃פ

passages.text: And in that day it will be said, “Surely this is our God; we have waited for Him, and He has saved us. This is the LORD for whom we have waited. Let us rejoice and be glad in His salvation.”
passages.sermon:
God will act on that day.
People will speak about God on that day.
They will say, “This is our God.”
We waited for Him.
He saved us.
This is the LORD.
We waited for Him.
Let us rejoice.
Let us be glad in His salvation.
passages.original: וְאָמַר֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא הִנֵּ֨ה אֱלֹהֵ֥ינוּ זֶ֛ה קִוִּ֥ינוּ ל֖וֹ וְיֽוֹשִׁיעֵ֑נוּ זֶ֤ה יְהוָה֙ קִוִּ֣ינוּ ל֔וֹ נָגִ֥ילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָ֖ה בִּישׁוּעָתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: For the hand of the LORD will rest on this mountain. But Moab will be trampled in his place as straw is trodden into the dung pile.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God over all the earth.
The LORD will place His hand on this mountain.
Moab is a nation that opposes God’s people.
God will trample Moab in its own land.
Moab will be crushed like straw is trampled in a dung pile.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ תָנ֥וּחַ יַד־ יְהוָ֖ה בָּהָ֣ר הַזֶּ֑ה וְנָ֤דוֹשׁ מוֹאָב֙ תַּחְתָּ֔יו כְּהִדּ֥וּשׁ מַתְבֵּ֖ן בְּמֵי מַדְמֵנָֽה׃

passages.text: He will spread out his hands within it, as a swimmer spreads his arms to swim. His pride will be brought low, despite the skill of his hands.
passages.sermon:
God will act in judgment against Moab.
He will spread out His hands in Moab.
He will do this like a swimmer spreads his arms to swim.
God will bring down Moab’s pride.
He will humble Moab, even though Moab uses all his skill.
passages.original: וּפֵרַ֤שׂ יָדָיו֙ בְּקִרְבּ֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר יְפָרֵ֥שׂ הַשֹּׂחֶ֖ה לִשְׂח֑וֹת וְהִשְׁפִּיל֙ גַּֽאֲוָת֔וֹ עִ֖ם אָרְבּ֥וֹת יָדָֽיו׃

passages.text: The high-walled fortress will be brought down, cast to the ground, into the dust.
passages.sermon:
God acts with power.
God brings down the high-walled fortress.
He casts the strong walls to the ground.
He brings them down into the dust.
passages.original: וּמִבְצַ֞ר מִשְׂגַּ֣ב חוֹמֹתֶ֗יךָ הֵשַׁ֥ח הִשְׁפִּ֛יל הִגִּ֥יעַ לָאָ֖רֶץ עַד־ עָפָֽר׃ס
